verdict.label: duplicate
verdict.why: The mobile and web useOlderSettledShelf hooks are nearly line-for-line the same. Both sort the scopes and key them by JSON. Both track requested pages per scope, reset them when the scope changes or the shelf is collapsed, and derive shelfScopes and shelfKey. Both read olderSettledThreads.shelfAtom and mount page rows through threadFamilies.mountRows in an effect, releasing them on cleanup. Both compute the frontier, loaded, loading, failed, retry, isListed and unloadedCount. The only differences are that NEW wraps sortOlderSettledScopes in useMemo and that the oxlint comment text differs. Neither affects behavior. This hook should move to a shared package, with each app importing it. The hook holds the whole shelf-state policy, so both copies can drift apart when one changes.

source_adjudication.contract: Own the older-settled shelf hook policy: scope-key requested-page state, expansion gating, scope/page derivation, read shelf atom, mount only requested page rows for current key, release mounts on effect replacement/unmount, expose frontier-based listing/count/loading/failure/retry facade.
source_adjudication.existing_shared_owner: Shared createOlderSettledThreadAtoms and threadFamilies.mountRows own data queries and mounting primitive. sortOlderSettledScopes/settledShelfFrontier/isListedSettledThread/unloadedOlderSettledCount own calculations. Neither owns hook requested-state, expansion gating, per-scope row mount/release lifecycle and retry facade; each endpoint implements it.
legitimate_variations: Mobile memoizes sorted scopes with useMemo; web sorts on render. Neither changes the intended stable scope-key policy.
Each app binds its own registry, thread atom instances and imports; a shared hook must accept dependencies or live above their shared binding.

Shared older-settled query/page atoms, frontier/count/list predicates and threadFamilies.mountRows/refcount implementation already own their primitives. Do not claim those as newly repeated implementation.
useOlderSettledShelfGrowth is outside this pair/operation; no extra family or pair acceptance inferred.
